name: Colorful USB Rechargeable Desktop Fan | Silent Cooling, LED Ambient Light, 3-Speed Rotation
description:
The Colorful Desktop Fan combines quiet cooling with modern design, making it perfect for bedrooms, offices, and study spaces. With USB recharging, LED ambient lights, and adjustable airflow, it offers both comfort and style. Compact yet powerful, this fan is ideal for work, rest, or travel.
Key Features
 LED ambient lighting for a calming atmosphere
 USB rechargeable with long-lasting battery
 3 adjustable speed levels for custom cooling
 180° rotation to direct airflow easily
 Ultra-quiet operation for work or sleep
 Compact & stylish design fits any space
Ingredients / Materials
ABS plastic body, electronic motor, LED lighting components, rechargeable lithium battery
How to Use
 Charge fully via USB before first use
 Press button to switch between 3 speed levels
 Adjust fan angle up to 180° for best airflow
 Turn on LED lights for ambient effect as desired
Package Includes
 1 × Colorful Desktop Fan
 1 × USB Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
